versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected compared to previous release.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the yino-ai skill.
- Enables image and video generation via yino.ai's APIs.
- Supports triggers for both image (Seedream) and video (Veo) creation.
- Requires a YINO_API_KEY for authentication.
- Provides guidance on API usage, project management, polling, batch processing, and file uploads.
- Includes agent-friendly error handling and documentation discovery for capabilities.
